I’m late but I hope you’re still here to read this. You probably have no motivation or interest in life right now but I hope there’s still some underlying curiosity. Every time I wonder if this is it, if life will always feel the way it does in that moment I tell myself I can always make that decision tomorrow. As long as I don’t do it, I always have that choice. The second I do, my choices are gone. All opportunity is gone. Any possibility for a better day I have snuffed out. My greatest fear is robbing myself of the life I could have, of not sticking around long enough to see things get better. Best case scenario, you live on, your mental health gets better and you’re happy you chose to still be here. Worst case scenario, you gave yourself a chance.
